description: Sanity ecosystem presets, then Roboto policy LAST so it wins - preset packageRules are appended in order and the last matching rule sets each option. The packageRules below are local to this repo and resolve after the org preset.

packageRules.description: Pinned exact to hold the Studio on the @sanity/ui v3 line (#70). Renovate reads an exact version as a pin to keep current, so it would propose bumps that drag v4 back in. `sanity` is here because the catalog pins it at 6.9.1; `sanity-plugin-lucide-icon-picker` is the package that pins the whole line and has no v4-compatible release. Drop when the Studio moves to v4 - TODO: that migration has no ticket yet, record its ROB id here once it is raised.

@sanity/ui and @sanity/icons are on carets and free to move inside v3; v4 is what the pins above exist to keep out - the icon picker imports Popover/Menu from the @sanity/ui root and TrashIcon/SyncIcon/EllipsisHorizontalIcon from the @sanity/icons root, both moved to subpaths in v4. Capping beats disabling so security and bug fixes still land.
Held at 7 to match the catalog: next-sanity 13.3.3 imports `unstable__adapter`, which @sanity/client 8 removed. Lift when next-sanity ships a v8-compatible release.
